class.name: ResourceLoaderOpenMPT
class.brief_description: Resource loader for tracker music files.
class.description: Handles automatic loading of tracker music files (MOD, XM, S3M, IT, etc.) as [AudioStreamOpenMPT] resources when imported into Godot. This class is registered automatically and you don't need to interact with it directly. Simply place tracker music files in your project and they will be imported as [AudioStreamOpenMPT] resources.
